sentences.text: Yes, RBI’s 2023 circular on Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts was withdrawn/repealed with effect from 2025-11-28 and was no longer in force on 2026-11-23.

The 2025 consolidation says the circulars listed in the Annex are withdrawn “with immediate effect” and “are hereby repealed,” and the rule finding identifies the 2023 penal-charges circular as one of those withdrawn circulars.
